summary: V6.25.27 verification — ALL 4 NEW V6.25.27 backend tests PASS (codex-PDF em-dash unicode header, ASCII codex regression, /validate audit shape, folio.inventory_state PATCH round-trip). All 34 V6.25.25/.26 regression tests still GREEN. Frontend end-to-end on Eli's character sheet (id 35b9746b30a24d2bafac5f117d673bd1): cp-balance-widget correctly REMOVED from read-only sheet (all 4 tabs); EquippedStrip + 6 slot tiles render at top of Mechanics tab; new InventoryPanel renders with all 10 tab pills + add button; auto-derived rows (Healing→Tinctures, Item→Apothecary bandolier, Wealth→Mundane, Magic→Apocophae's Field Kit, plus persisted Test Potion consumable) all visible; History tab shows 'POINTS SPENT 35 / 84' from /validate (audit hint 'was 45' shown alongside) — NOT the stale 45; Builder edit window mounts cp-balance-widget with Total 84 / Spent 35 and pre-approval chip visible. One minor cosmetic finding documented below.

issues: There are now TWO point displays visible at the same time: (a) the new top-banner cp-balance-widget showing 'CP BANK · pre-approval (primer) · TOTAL 84 · SPENT 35 · REMAINING 49' (correct, /validate-driven) and (b) the legacy right-side 'POINTS 45 / 90' panel (using character.spent=45 and total_points=90 — inconsistent with the audit). Spec says CP Bank moved to the builder; consider removing or rewiring the legacy 'POINTS 45/90' panel so all three surfaces (CP Bank widget, Rules Audit, History) consistently agree on 35/84.

History tab POINTS SPENT card shows '35 / 84' (correct) with sub-text 'audit · was 45' — this is fine for transparency but slightly cluttered; consider hiding the 'was 45' hint once /validate is the source of truth.

action_items: Optional cleanup: in CharacterBuilder, remove or rewire the legacy 'POINTS 45 / 90' summary panel (right column) to read from /validate so it aligns with the new CpBalanceWidget. Currently shows stale 45/90 alongside the new 84/35 banner.
Optional polish: hide the 'audit · was 45' hint under sheet-history-points-spent now that /validate is canonical.
critical_code_review_comments: codex_pdf.py and character_pdf.py latin-1 strip is correct and self-contained — header now safe even for em-dash/non-ASCII campaign names; regression tests pass for both the dash and ASCII campaigns.

InventoryPanel deriveRows path correctly synthesises rows when folio.inventory_state is null on first render (verified: Apothecary bandolier / Tinctures / Wealth all visible despite Eli's stored state having only the manually-PATCHed 'Test Potion').
PATCH /characters/{cid}/folio with bucket=inventory_state correctly merges and persists items + readied_ids + charges_max/current — round-trip GET confirms all fields preserved.

/validate response shape is now self-describing (total_points, breakdown.total_spent, approved_for_play, app_validated, gm_approved bools) — UI-side reconciliation across CP Bank widget / Rules Audit / History tab is straightforward.
